fields.FIR_Description: On 2025-08-26 at approximately 00:15, it was reported that the main gate of the complainant near Kalai Puram Apartment Complex in Chennai was defaced and partly broken. Gokul Karuppasamy reported the matter orally at Chennai Central PS; the contact number given was 9000000346. The complaint refers to Vasanthi Selvam, a co-worker, reachable on 9000000353. No identifying details of the suspected person were available at the time of registration. Kishore Selvam (9000000323) was mentioned as a person who was present nearby. The complainant mentioned CCTV footage, photographs and a witness statement.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Unidentified persons allegedly damaged the property while it was unattended.
fields.Keywords: vandalism, property damage, photograph, associate, witness, night, apartment complex, CCTV
